title: Amazon ruined this box
text: This subscription used to be great and feature a lot of very cool things. Aside from the Deadpool box back in the summer, every box has been incredibly underwhelming since Amazon took over. All of the negative reviews over the past few months are 100% justified. Look at what was included in the collector boxes before Amazon bought the rights to it, and you'll see how terribly these boxes have been lately.
label: negative
